connect.guideSummary: How to get a service account key (5 steps)
connect.guideStep1: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Library → search for Google Analytics Data API and enable it.
connect.guideStep2: IAM & Admin → Service Accounts → Create Service Account (skip role grants).
connect.guideStep3: Open the created service account → Keys tab → Add Key → Create new key → JSON → download.
connect.guideStep4: Drop the downloaded file below or paste its contents.
connect.guideStep5: In Google Analytics → Admin → Property Access Management → click + → add the service account's email (the client_email in the JSON) with Viewer role.
connect.dropPromptPost: key file here or click to browse
connect.propIdHelp: Google Analytics → Admin → Property details → numeric Property ID (not the Measurement ID).
connect.propagateHintPre: Just connected? Wait 1–2 minutes for the property to propagate, then click
connect.errFileSize: File too large — service account keys are typically under 5 KB
connect.errMissingFields: Invalid service account key — missing client_email or private_key
connect.errPasteKey: Paste or drop a service account JSON key

error.permissionTitle: Service account does not have access to this GA4 property
error.permissionStep1: Open Google Analytics → Admin → Property Access Management
error.permissionStep3: Paste the service account email (the client_email in your JSON)
error.invalidArgStep1: Go to GA4 → Admin → Property details
error.invalidArgStep2: Copy the numeric Property ID (e.g. 123456789) — not the Measurement ID (G-XXXX)
error.unauthStep1: Re-download the JSON key from Google Cloud → IAM → Service Accounts
error.unauthStep2: Make sure you copied the entire file (it starts with { "type": "service_account" )
error.apiDisabledTitle: Google Analytics Data API is not enabled
error.apiDisabledStep1: Go to Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Library
error.apiDisabledStep2: Search for "Google Analytics Data API" and click Enable
